title: Agonize
summary: AG'ONIZE, verb transitive [Gr. to strive. See Agony.] To write with extreme pain; to suffer violent anguish. To smart and agonize at every pore. AG'ONIZE, verb transitive To distress with extreme pain

inlines.v: AG'ONIZE, verb transitive [Gr. to strive. See Agony.] To write with extreme pain; to suffer violent anguish. To smart and agonize at every pore. AG'ONIZE, verb transitive To distress with extreme pain; to torture.
